text:
taylor_marketing: heads up — saw ~40 unassigned leads hit the queue in a 2m burst, claim latency spiked and RR started skipping owners. anyone else see this?
anya_sales_ops: saw it, thank you. HubSpot enrichment lagged for ~45s, then lead creation + claim happened simultaneously.
katie_revops: oof. that's the race we discussed. what's current RR config? is it sticky on contact owner or account owner?
ben_eng: RR is based on lead owner rotation in HubSpot workflow. enrichment webhook reply came after lead create so the lead hit the queue with no company data.
taylor_marketing: consequence was many going to overflow pool; SDRs got duplicates when enrichment backfilled
nate_growth: quick idea: stagger enrichment window so we delay claim by Xs until enrichment completes; fallback to immediate after Ys
anya_sales_ops: agree. propose: 30s soft-delay + heartbeat that marks lead stale at 90s and puts into overflow
katie_revops: SLA change needs to reflect in docs and SF lead assignment rule. also add a guard for >2 enrichment retries
ben_eng: can implement a tiny state machine in the enrichment lambda. pseudo:
``
if enrichment_complete -> create lead + claim
else -> create lead with pending flag, schedule claim in 30s
if enrichment retries > 2 -> route to enrichment-fallback queue
```
anya_sales_ops: can we do HubSpot workflow changes instead of lambda? less infra change
ben_eng: yes, we can. create lead, set property `enrichment_status=pending`, use workflow to wait 30s or until webhook sets `enrichment_status=done` and then assign owner via RR
katie_revops: need to update SF inbound APEX mapping too, otherwise duplicate ownerships
taylor_marketing: what's the rollout plan? small percentage? canary by geo?
anya_sales_ops: start with 10% of EU leads for 48hrs, monitor unclaimed rate and owner churn
nate_growth: metrics to watch: time-to-first-claim, duplicate assignments, SDR acceptance rate. target TTF claim < 45s for 90% after rollout
ben_eng: will add tracing tags so we can correlate enrichment webhook latency -> claim outcome
hubspot_bot: Workflow 'RR delayed claim' created by @ben_eng
taylor_marketing: thanks. can someone draft the playbook steps for on-call and SDRs if overflow happens? short doc + canned responses
anya_sales_ops: i'll draft now and ping for review :thumbsup:
katie_revops: added to Q3 ops plan. update the runbook once canary metrics look good
taylor_marketing: cool — moving to PR for hubspot workflow. tagging @anya @ben_eng for reviews
